mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic) antagonizes clonidine's (alpha-2 agonist) antihypertensive and anti-ADHD effects through opposing adrenergic mechanisms, risking blood pressure destabilization and reduced therapeutic efficacy.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, monitor blood pressure closely and consider alternative ADHD agents (atomoxetine, guanfacine); abrupt clonidine discontinuation during amphetamine use risks hypertensive crisis.
